node.statement: Centered graph differentiation: for every admissible algebra and U in calU, the graph map of lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control centered at U satisfies g_U(0)=0 and ||Dg_U(0)|| <= C0*epsilon_r, and its graph-chart parametrization has derivative L_U(I+Dg_U(0)) at 0; hence T_U calU is exactly the image of that map.
